description: This excitation systems consists of an alternator main exciter feeding its output via non-controlled rectifiers. The exciter does not employ self-excitation, and the voltage regulator power is taken from a source that is not affected by external transients. Parameters of IEEE Std 421.5 Type AC6A Excitacion System. ESAC6A in PSSE and PSLF

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

base_power.description: Base power for this model's per-unit parameters. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the dynamic injection that names this model; the ingestion layer reconciles a difference. Units: MVA.

Kh.description: Exciter field current regulator feedback gain

VH_max.description: Exciter field current limiter maximum output

Th.description: Exciter field current limiter denominator (lag) time constant

Tj.description: Exciter field current limiter (lead) time constant

Kc.description: Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance

Kd.description: Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances

E_sat.description: Exciter output voltage for saturation factor

Se.description: Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage

title: ESAC6A
